items.label: Vintage Side Table
items.value: This side table features a cozy wood-grain finish, centered around its graceful oval tabletop and supported by intricately carved vintage-style legs. The design beautifully blends modern elegance with timeless charm, bringing a touch of understated sophistication and retro warmth to any room

items.label: 3-Tier Storage
items.value: This small end table for small space, featuring a 3-tier open shelf to hold everything you need within easy reach—books, magazines, and decorative accents—while maximizing storage potential in minimal floor space

items.label: Compact Side Table
items.value: Sized at 11.8''D x 15.7''W x 22.4''H, this compact side table fits seamlessly beside most sofas or beds. Its versatile 22.4'' height adapts as a couch side table, drink table, nightstand, plant stand, or accent table. Lightweight yet sturdy, the 3-tier storage design adding everyday practicality to any room

items.label: Premium Quality
items.value: This small side table is crafted with premium MDF boards and a water-resistant finish, paired with sturdy solid wood legs for lasting durability. Its three-tier design with rounded edges offers ample storage while preventing accidental bumps

items.label: Easy Assembly
items.value: With its simple structure and detailed instructions, you can quickly assemble the small side table without any tools required. If you have any problem, do not hesitate to reach out to us

items.value: The product comes with an assembly guide that provides detailed instructions for easy assembly without the need for tools.
